findings.title: Task-folder gate-summary.md target-layout fixture is stale vs the normative design 9.11.1
findings.problem: Commit 0b7fc2e updated the normative fixture (design 9.11.1), the golden tasks, and added a 'Review findings addressed' section to gate-summary.md, but did not update the ASCII target-layout block inside gate-summary.md. That block still shows the pre-fix state: SS/CS/scratch only (no X -> EXIT seed row), status 'Last: 12:06 | Prof: default | Aliases: 2 | Rows 1-2 visible', and no Zoom segment. The normative spec now shows the seed row first, Aliases: 3 | Rows 1-3 visible, and Zoom: 100%. A reader comparing the two sees a contradiction. The gate-summary is a working note, not a normative spec, so this does not change the verdict.
findings.fix: Replace the ASCII fixture block in gate-summary.md with the current design 9.11.1 fixture (seed X -> EXIT first data row, Zoom: 100% present, status Aliases: 3 | Rows 1-3 visible), or add a one-line note 'Normative fixture is design 9.11.1; this copy is illustrative and may trail it.'

priorFindings.note: Normative fixture 9.11.1 and golden task 9.6.1/9.6.2 now include the X -> EXIT seed row as the first data row with status Aliases: 3 | Rows 1-3 visible; 7.28 asserts the seed row present. Fixed by commit 0b7fc2e (preferred option).

Tagging notes added to the command-configurator 7.14-7.28 and screen-snapshot-scrm 30.32-30.40 blocks, and the ispf-table-editor Req 12 header reworded to 'CR-NR-116 (building on CR-NR-115)'. Fixed by commit 0b7fc2e.
Design 9.11.2 D5 now calls SS 'a shipped SCRM alias row (its template is None)' and reserves 'seed row' for the CR-CH-116 X -> EXIT row. Fixed by commit 0b7fc2e.
